```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

**Purpose:**
Generates the gene signature used in downstream analyses 

**Inputs:**
1. A375 DESeq2 object
    Generated by: `01_bulkRNAseq_processing.RMD`

2. WM793 DESeq2 object
    Generated by: `01_bulkRNAseq_processing.RMD`
    
**Outputs:**
1. Gene signature: `gene_signature.gmt`

# Set up necessary background

## Libraries

```{r Libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(ggvenn)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)

})
```

## Set File Locations
```{r}
resultsDir1 <- here("data", "data_objects")
resultsDir2 <- here("data", "gene_sig")

# Automatically create the folder on the computer if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(resultsDir2)) {
  dir.create(resultsDir2, recursive = TRUE)
}
```


# Load Data
```{r}
# load objects
dds_OE <- readRDS(file.path(resultsDir1, "dds_OE.rds"))
```

# Extract normalized_counts function
```{r}
extract_counts <- function(ddsHTSeq, normalization) {
  counts <- counts(ddsHTSeq, normalized = normalization)

  # store ENSG IDs as an additional column
  counts <- cbind(ENSG_ID = rownames(counts), counts)

  # strip "." from ENSG ID row names
  rownames(counts) <- gsub("\\..*", "", rownames(counts))
  counts <- data.frame(counts)

  return(counts)
}
```

# Generate extract_stats_results function to clean and combine document
```{r}
extract_stats_results <- function(df, human_chip) {
  combined_res <- as.data.frame(df)

  # store ENSG IDs as an additional column
  combined_res <- cbind(ENSG_ID = rownames(combined_res), combined_res)

  # strip "." from ENSG ID row names
  rownames(combined_res) <- gsub("\\..*", "", rownames(combined_res))
  combined_res <- data.frame(combined_res)

  return(combined_res)
}
```

# Perform Contrasts

```{r}
# perform contrasts & create dataframe w/ counts + stats results
# create normcounts for OE
normCounts_OE <- extract_counts(dds_OE, normalization = T)


# A375 FOXD3 DOX vs No Dox
FOXD3_A375_DOX_NoDOX <- results(dds_OE, contrast = c("condition", "DOXFOXD3A375", "NODOXFOXD3A375"))
FOXD3_A375_DOX_NoDOX <- extract_stats_results(FOXD3_A375_DOX_NoDOX)
colnames(FOXD3_A375_DOX_NoDOX) <- paste(colnames(FOXD3_A375_DOX_NoDOX), "FOXD3_A375_DOX_NoDOX", sep = "_")

# A375 LACZ Dox vs No Dox
LACZ_A375_DOX_NoDOX <- as.data.frame(results(dds_OE, contrast = c("condition", "DOXLACZA375", "NODOXLACZA375")))
LACZ_A375_DOX_NoDOX <- extract_stats_results(LACZ_A375_DOX_NoDOX)
colnames(LACZ_A375_DOX_NoDOX) <- paste(colnames(LACZ_A375_DOX_NoDOX), "LACZ_A375_DOX_NoDOX", sep = "_")

# WM793 FOXD3 Dox vs No Dox
FOXD3_WM793_DOX_NoDOX <- as.data.frame(results(dds_OE, contrast = c("condition", "DOXFOXD3WM793", "NODOXFOXD3WM793")))
FOXD3_WM793_DOX_NoDOX <- extract_stats_results(FOXD3_WM793_DOX_NoDOX)
colnames(FOXD3_WM793_DOX_NoDOX) <- paste(colnames(FOXD3_WM793_DOX_NoDOX), "FOXD3_WM793_DOX_NoDOX", sep = "_")

# WM793 LACZ Dox vs No Dox
LACZ_WM793_DOX_NoDOX <- as.data.frame(results(dds_OE, contrast = c("condition", "DOXLACZWM793", "NODOXLACZWM793")))
LACZ_WM793_DOX_NoDOX <- extract_stats_results(LACZ_WM793_DOX_NoDOX)
colnames(LACZ_WM793_DOX_NoDOX) <- paste(colnames(LACZ_WM793_DOX_NoDOX), "LACZ_WM793_DOX_NoDOX", sep = "_")

# A375 FOXD3 Dox vs LACZ Dox
FOXD3_LACZ_A375_DOX <- as.data.frame(results(dds_OE, contrast = c("condition", "DOXFOXD3A375", "DOXLACZA375")))
FOXD3_LACZ_A375_DOX <- extract_stats_results(FOXD3_LACZ_A375_DOX)
colnames(FOXD3_LACZ_A375_DOX) <- paste(colnames(FOXD3_LACZ_A375_DOX), "FOXD3_LACZ_A375_DOX", sep = "_")

# WM793 FOXD3 Dox vs LACZ Dox
FOXD3_LACZ_WM793_DOX <- as.data.frame(results(dds_OE, contrast = c("condition", "DOXFOXD3WM793", "DOXLACZWM793")))
FOXD3_LACZ_WM793_DOX <- extract_stats_results(FOXD3_LACZ_WM793_DOX)
colnames(FOXD3_LACZ_WM793_DOX) <- paste(colnames(FOXD3_LACZ_WM793_DOX), "FOXD3_LACZ_WM793_DOX", sep = "_")
```

# Generate significant A375 Genes

```{r A375_OE_Sig_Genes}
# get genes from OE_A375 Dataset
OE_A375_Sig_Genes_up <- as.data.frame(
  # get the intersection of significant dif A375 FOXD3 & insignificant/not dif A375 LACZ
  intersect(
    # get the significant differentially expressed genes from A375 FOXD3
    (subset(FOXD3_A375_DOX_NoDOX, (padj_FOXD3_A375_DOX_NoDOX < 0.05) & (log2FoldChange_FOXD3_A375_DOX_NoDOX) >= 1))$ENSG_ID_FOXD3_A375_DOX_NoDOX,

    # get the EITHER insignificant OR not differentially expressed genes from A375 LACZ
    (subset(LACZ_A375_DOX_NoDOX, (padj_LACZ_A375_DOX_NoDOX >= 0.05) | (abs(log2FoldChange_LACZ_A375_DOX_NoDOX) < 1)))$ENSG_ID_LACZ_A375_DOX_NoDOX
  )
)

OE_A375_Sig_Genes_down <- as.data.frame(
  # get the intersection of significant dif A375 FOXD3 & insignificant/not dif A375 LACZ
  intersect(
    # get the significant differentially expressed genes from A375 FOXD3
    (subset(FOXD3_A375_DOX_NoDOX, (padj_FOXD3_A375_DOX_NoDOX < 0.05) & log2FoldChange_FOXD3_A375_DOX_NoDOX <= -1))$ENSG_ID_FOXD3_A375_DOX_NoDOX,

    # get the EITHER insignificant OR not differentially expressed genes from A375 LACZ
    (subset(LACZ_A375_DOX_NoDOX, (padj_LACZ_A375_DOX_NoDOX >= 0.05) | (abs(log2FoldChange_LACZ_A375_DOX_NoDOX) < 1)))$ENSG_ID_LACZ_A375_DOX_NoDOX
  )
)

# update column names
colnames(OE_A375_Sig_Genes_up) <- {
  "ENSG_ID"
}
colnames(OE_A375_Sig_Genes_down) <- {
  "ENSG_ID"
}

# combine the two dataframes
OE_A375_Sig_Genes <- rbind(OE_A375_Sig_Genes_up, OE_A375_Sig_Genes_down)
```

# Generate significant WM793 genes

```{r OE_WM793_Sig_Genes}
# get genes from WM_793 dataset
OE_WM793_Sig_Genes_up <- as.data.frame(

  intersect(

    (subset(FOXD3_WM793_DOX_NoDOX, (padj_FOXD3_WM793_DOX_NoDOX < 0.05) & log2FoldChange_FOXD3_WM793_DOX_NoDOX >= 1))$ENSG_ID,
    # get the EITHER insignificant OR not differentially expressed genes from WM793 LACZ
    (subset(LACZ_WM793_DOX_NoDOX, (padj_LACZ_WM793_DOX_NoDOX >= 0.05) | (abs(log2FoldChange_LACZ_WM793_DOX_NoDOX) < 1)))$ENSG_ID
  )
)

OE_WM793_Sig_Genes_down <- as.data.frame(
  # get the intersection of significant dif WM793 FOXD3 & insignifican/not dif WM793 LACZ
  intersect(
    # get the significant differentially expressed genes from WM793 FOXD3
    (subset(FOXD3_WM793_DOX_NoDOX, (padj_FOXD3_WM793_DOX_NoDOX < 0.05) & log2FoldChange_FOXD3_WM793_DOX_NoDOX <= -1))$ENSG_ID,
    # get the EITHER insignificant OR not differentially expressed genes from WM793 LACZ
    (subset(LACZ_WM793_DOX_NoDOX, (padj_LACZ_WM793_DOX_NoDOX >= 0.05) | (abs(log2FoldChange_LACZ_WM793_DOX_NoDOX) < 1)))$ENSG_ID
  )

# update column names
colnames(OE_WM793_Sig_Genes_up) <- {

OE_WM793_Sig_Genes <- rbind(OE_WM793_Sig_Genes_up, OE_WM793_Sig_Genes_down)
```

# Generate intersection of A375 and WM793 significant genes by regulation

```{r OE_Intersection}
# upregulated intersection
Venn_Diag_up <- list(
  A375 = OE_A375_Sig_Genes_up$ENSG_ID,
  WM793 = OE_WM793_Sig_Genes_up$ENSG_ID
)
ggvenn(
  Venn_Diag_up,
  columns = c("A375", "WM793"),
  stroke_size = 0.5
) +
  ggtitle("Overlapping Upregulated Genes in A375 & WM793 Melanoma Cell Lines")


# downregulated intersection
Venn_Diag_down <- list(
  A375 = OE_A375_Sig_Genes_down$ENSG_ID,
  WM793 = OE_WM793_Sig_Genes_down$ENSG_ID
)
ggvenn(
  Venn_Diag_down,
  columns = c("A375", "WM793"),
  stroke_size = 0.5
) +
  ggtitle("Overlapping Downregulated Genes in A375 & WM793 Melanoma Cell Lines")
```

# Generate intersection of A375 and WM793 all significant genes

```{r}
# get the intersection of genes in OE A375 & WM793 cells
Venn_Diag_list <- list(
  A375 = OE_A375_Sig_Genes$ENSG_ID,
  WM793 = OE_WM793_Sig_Genes$ENSG_ID
)

# print ggvenn to results
ggvenn(
  Venn_Diag_list,
  columns = c("A375", "WM793"),
  fill_color = c("black", "white"),
  stroke_size = 0.5
) +
  ggtitle("Overlapping Genes in A375 & WM793 Melanoma Cell Lines")
```

# Merge the two cell lines and print final gene signature to gmt file

```{r write_files}
# get current date
file_loc <- paste0(resultsDir2, "/")
OE_Sig_Up_gmt <- paste0(file_loc, "OE_Sig_Up", ".gmt")
OE_Sig_Down_gmt <- paste0(file_loc, "OE_Sig_Down", ".gmt")
OE_Sig <- paste0(file_loc, "FOXD3_Sig", ".gmt")

# merge gene signature into one
Sig_Up_toprint <- merge(OE_A375_Sig_Genes_up, OE_WM793_Sig_Genes_up)
Sig_Down_toprint <- merge(OE_A375_Sig_Genes_down, OE_WM793_Sig_Genes_down)

# remove the extra digits
Sig_Up_toprint$ENSG_ID <- str_extract(Sig_Up_toprint$ENSG_ID, ".*(?=\\.)")
Sig_Down_toprint$ENSG_ID <- str_extract(Sig_Down_toprint$ENSG_ID, ".*(?=\\.)")

# remove FOXD3 to not obsfuscate results
Sig_Up_toprint_filtered <- Sig_Up_toprint %>% filter(ENSG_ID != "ENSG00000187140")


# generate gmt
gmt <- c(
  paste(c("Upregulated", "Upregulated", Sig_Up_toprint_filtered[[1]]), collapse = "\t"),
  paste(c("Downregulated", "Downregulated", Sig_Down_toprint[[1]]), collapse = "\t")
)

# print to gmt
writeLines(gmt, OE_Sig)
```

**Note on gene annotation:**  
Gene-symbol annotations may change between annotation database versions.
The HGNC gene-symbol signature provided with this repository is the version
used for the analyses reported in the manuscript and is therefore used as
the input for downstream analyses. It is therefore recommended to use the included gmt signatures for downstream analyses. 

```{r}
# generate HUGO version
gene_vector_up <- as.character(Sig_Up_toprint_filtered$ENSG_ID)
gene_vector_down <- as.character(Sig_Down_toprint$ENSG_ID)

hugo_symbols_up <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = gene_vector_up,
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  column = "SYMBOL",
  multiVals = "first"
) 

hugo_symbols_down <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = gene_vector_down,
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  column = "SYMBOL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

#If a gene doesn't have a HUGO symbol, keep the original Ensembl ID
hugo_symbols_up[is.na(hugo_symbols_up)] <- gene_vector_up[is.na(hugo_symbols_up)]
hugo_symbols_down[is.na(hugo_symbols_down)] <- gene_vector_down[is.na(hugo_symbols_down)]


# This returns a clean data frame. Extract the target gene names:
hugo_symbols_up_df <- as.data.frame(hugo_symbols_up)
hugo_symbols_down_df <- as.data.frame(hugo_symbols_down)

# print HUGO to gmt
gmt_hugo <- c(
  paste(c("Upregulated", "Upregulated", hugo_symbols_up_df$hugo_symbols_up), collapse = "\t"),
  paste(c("Downregulated", "Downregulated", hugo_symbols_down_df$hugo_symbols_down), collapse = "\t")
)

# print to gmt
OE_Sig_hugo <- paste0(file_loc, "FOXD3_Sig_HUGO", ".gmt")
writeLines(gmt_hugo, OE_Sig_hugo)

```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
